+def test_label_encoder_empty_array():
+    # Test that transforming an empty array on a fitted encoder returns an empty array
+    le = LabelEncoder()
+    le.fit([1, 2])
+    result = le.transform([])
+    assert_array_equal(result, [])
+    assert result.dtype == np.int64
+    
+    # Test with string labels
+    le = LabelEncoder()
+    le.fit(['a', 'b'])
+    result = le.transform([])
+    assert_array_equal(result, [])
+    assert result.dtype == np.int64
